description:
compile_root_jit has 0 production callers. Its three sibling front doors all ship: run_root_interp 4 call sites, run_root_jit 2, compile_root_aot 1. Only tests call it.

So it is one of: dead public API that should be deleted, or a real three-path parity gap where a JIT compile-without-run entry point ought to be reachable from the CLI. Establish which from the code, then act. Do not cfg(test) a front door to make a lint quiet.
title: Decide compile_root_jit: dead API or parity gap
